name: Ambenonium

similar.name: Diclofenac
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems and heart harm

summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, Ambenonium has low risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Diclofenac carries an official boxed warning in the United States for damage to the nervous system, stomach or gut injury, and heart harm [3].
